requirement: on_hold(revisions_exhausted)로 종결된 prompt-refiner-shadow-execution-runner-v1의 마지막 세 finding을 사람의 명시적 continuation 결정으로 닫는 successor exchange다. runner의 pre/post-dispatch, intent 누락, reservation release 실패와 terminal-write 불명 경로는 응답 전에 content-free 운영 incident를 보고하되 prompt, refined prompt, model output과 provider 오류 원문을 전달하지 않고 alert 전달 실패가 원래 실행 결과를 바꾸지 않는다. dispatch intent writer가 reservation_expired를 반환하면 DB가 이미 reservation을 expired로 닫았으므로 release를 재시도하지 않고 원래 dispatch refusal을 보존한다. contract의 routeMaxDurationSeconds와 Next route의 정적 maxDuration literal을 회귀 테스트가 직접 비교해 route cap과 240초 invocation admission budget의 분리를 막는다. 기존 owner-only, default-off, exact 16-case, actual tokenizer, no retry/fallback/redispatch, durable intent/terminal, unknown latch, no product Chat 계약은 유지한다. author는 Codex, reviewer는 Claude Code Max이며 승인된 --skip-preflight 예외 아래 Read/Grep/Glob only와 strict MCP로 검토한다.
completionCriteria: 기존 exchange의 open finding 세 건을 새 digest에서 계승하고 기존 on_hold 기록이나 verdict를 수정하지 않는다.

incident delivery 자체가 실패해도 원래 dispatch/terminal 오류 분류와 no-retry 결과를 보존하고 고정 content-free fallback log만 남긴다.
recordIntent의 reservation_expired는 release를 호출하지 않고 PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_DISPATCH_REFUSED를 보존하며 다른 pre-intent refusal은 active reservation을 정확히 한 번 release한다.
run contract digest는 routeMaxDurationSeconds=300을 포함하고 테스트는 execute route의 정적 maxDuration literal과 계약 상수를 직접 비교하며 invocation budget이 그보다 작은지 검증한다.

Claude verdict는 새 package digest와 결속하며 최초 검토와 최대 두 번의 수정 검토 후 actionable finding이 남으면 on_hold다.

findings.claim: `runnerCauseCode` only understands thrown values, so the two incidents whose cause is a non-thrown fixed enum — the reservation-release refusal (`released.reason`, a `PromptRefinerReservationRefusal`) and the literal `"intent_missing"` — are reported as `causeCode: "non_error_throw"`, discarding the one diagnostic code available on a release failure in a system that forbids retrying to find out.
findings.reproduction: In tests/promptRefinerShadowRunner.test.mjs replace the fixture's `release` with `async () => { events.push("release"); return { ok: false, reason: "reservation_not_found" }; }` and run `npm run test:prompt-refiner-shadow-live-adapter`. In the "a pre-intent failure releases once" case, the second incident (`context.phase === "reservation_release"`) has `error === "non_error_throw"` and `context.causeCode === "non_error_throw"`, and `"reservation_not_found"` appears nowhere in `JSON.stringify(world.incidents)` — even though that refusal union (lib/promptRefinerReservationAuthority.ts:41-48) is already a fixed content-free enum that the criterion's "고정 코드" allows. Expected: the refusal code reaches the incident.

findings.claim: The `failIncidentReporting` fixture option is defined but never set by any test, so the completion criterion that a failed incident delivery preserves the original error classification (lib/promptRefinerShadowRunner.ts:121-133) has code but no regression guarding it.
findings.reproduction: `rg -n "failIncidentReporting" tests/` returns only the fixture definition at line 164; no test passes the option. Adding `const world = fixture({ failBeforeIntentAt: 0, failIncidentReporting: true })` and asserting the rejection is still `PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_PRE_DISPATCH_FAILED` (and that the swallowing path is taken) closes it; removing the `try/catch` in `reportRunnerIncident` currently breaks no test.

inheritedFindings.claim: Every failure path in the one-run runner discards the causal error without binding it, logging it, or reporting an incident, so a halted paid shadow leaves only a generic code (`PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_PRE_DISPATCH_FAILED` / `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` / `TERMINAL_WRITE_UNKNOWN`) and no record of why, in a system that forbids retrying to find out.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: `rg -n 'console\.|reportOperationalIncident' lib/promptRefinerShadowRunner.ts` returns nothing, and both catch clauses bind no error variable. The route cannot compensate: app/api/admin/prompt-refiner/shadow-run/execute/route.ts:152-153 returns `promptRefinerShadowRunnerErrorResponse(error)` before ever reaching its `console.error` at line 160. Concretely, tests/promptRefinerShadowRunner.test.mjs `failAfterIntentAt` throws `new Error("after intent")` and the only observable output is the 503 code — the message reaches no sink. lib/maintenance.ts:26 shows the project's existing `reportOperationalIncident` channel for exactly this class of event.

inheritedFindings.claim: When `recordPromptRefinerShadowDispatchIntent` returns `reservation_expired` it has already transitioned the row to `expired`, so the runner's subsequent release necessarily fails and the operator is told `PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_PRE_DISPATCH_RELEASE_FAILED` ("could not close its reservation") about a reservation that is in fact correctly closed.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: lib/promptRefinerShadowRunStore.ts:782-786 sets `status: "expired"` and returns `{ok:false, reason:"reservation_expired"}`; that `!intent.ok` branch (runner line 205-211) throws inside `onDispatch`, so the runner's catch at line 215 sees `attemptId === null` and calls `dependencies.release(reservation)`. lib/promptRefinerReservationAuthority.ts:316 refuses any non-`reserved` row with `reservation_not_active`, so `released.ok` is false and the runner refuses with the release-failure code instead of the real `reservation_expired` cause. No test covers this path: tests/promptRefinerShadowRunner.test.mjs has no fixture where `recordIntent` returns `ok:false`.

inheritedFindings.claim: The budget guard compares against the literal `300_000` rather than the route's declared `maxDuration`, so lowering `export const maxDuration` would leave a 240 s admission budget that exceeds the platform cap with no gate failing.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: Change `export const maxDuration = 300;` to `60` in app/api/admin/prompt-refiner/shadow-run/execute/route.ts and run `npm run test:prompt-refiner-shadow-live-adapter`; it stays green, and `promptRefinerShadowRunContractProblems()` still returns `[]`. tests/cronClientTimeouts.test.mjs:52 shows the project's existing idiom for parsing `export const maxDuration` out of a route and binding it to an in-code budget.
